_comment: Canonical query catalog for the Benefits Advising Hub refresh. Each entry: id -> sql file, grain, params, out_csv (where refresh_advising_hub.py writes it, relative to BenOps folder), and the JSON field(s) it feeds in _renewal_vnext/advising_vnext_data.json. Cohort = renewal_date IN the 6 dates; substitute {{cohort_dates}} with a quoted, comma-separated date list.

feeds: rate_parse_success (Y=all parse records ok / N / null)

carry_forward_not_reconstructed._note: Fields still carried forward per-opp from the prior published dataset (frozen) because they genuinely cannot be cleanly sourced from Snowflake, or are out of the current reconstruction scope. Open/PF live-refreshed fields have been REMOVED from this list (see queries above). Anything remaining is flagged with the reason.

unmappable_from_snowflake._note: EMPTY. The three groups that used to live here (recert_status; packets_files/packet_carriers; intro_call/intro_call_date) are NOT in the DATA_WAREHOUSE_RC1 SF mirror and are now pulled LIVE from the Salesforce MCP by the task orchestrator each morning -> see the 'salesforce_mcp' section below and sf_mcp_pull_spec.md. Nothing remains genuinely-unrecoverable here.

out_of_scope_this_cycle._note: Empty. The Sept-10 reconstruction wired every previously-carried Snowflake-sourced field LIVE on Open/PF (Closed stays frozen): rate_index.sql (rate_increase_pct, rate_status, rate_structure), time_in_rfd.sql (days_to_default), lf.sql (lf_savings_pct/band/quote/in_alt), auto_finalize.sql (automation_eligible, rate_parse_success), rec_timing.sql (cycle_open, tl_cycle_open, default_rec_sent, default_rec_built + derived timing), email_due.sql (email_due*, email_pending*, email_received_date). See queries above; fields populated in refresh_advising_hub.merge_freeze Open/PF branch.
out_of_scope_this_cycle.lf_classifier_note: lf_savings_pct/band/quote/in_alt are computed purely from Snowflake (GROUP_LEVEL_PLAN_RATES enrolled-avg + medical_package_offerings). The local lf_signal_classifier.py (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + Salesforce) only enriches LF reason codes for the separate LF-conversion dashboard; the pipeline invokes it as an OPTIONAL guarded step (skipped headless). The four hub LF fields do NOT require it.

salesforce_mcp._note: Three field groups that are NOT in the Snowflake SF mirror (DATA_WAREHOUSE_RC1 salesforce_production_no_pii) and are therefore pulled LIVE from the Salesforce MCP by the TASK ORCHESTRATOR each morning BEFORE the python pipeline runs (python does NOT make these calls). The orchestrator writes 3 CSVs into _renewal_vnext/out/; refresh_advising_hub.py merge_freeze reads them and populates the fields on OPEN/PF opps only. If a CSV is absent (e.g. a headless python-only run) or an opp is not in it, the prior value carries forward; Closed opps always stay frozen. Opp-id source = _renewal_vnext/advising_vnext_data.json where closed==false (~7,390 opps). Batch LinkedEntityId/Opportunity__c IN (...) at <=200 ids/query (packets: <=~50 ids/query to keep MCP output small). Full spec: sf_mcp_pull_spec.md. CSVs are company/plan grain only (flags, picklist, filenames/carriers) — no employee names/emails/phones/note text.

intro_call / intro_call_date.field: Intro_Call_Completed__c (Checkbox); intro_call_date = CreatedDate (date) of the case where the checkbox is true. NOTE: there is NO dedicated intro-call-completed date field on Case; CreatedDate of the completed Benefits Renewal Case is the proxy, matching the original pipeline's intro.json semantics.
intro_call / intro_call_date.soql: SELECT Opportunity__c oid, MIN(CreatedDate) mind FROM Case WHERE RecordType.Name='Benefits Renewal Case' AND Intro_Call_Completed__c=true AND Opportunity__c IN (:batch) GROUP BY Opportunity__c
intro_call / intro_call_date.derive: intro_call='Y' for any opp returned else 'N'; intro_call_date = MIN(CreatedDate) date-part for returned opps, else null.
intro_call / intro_call_date.out_csv: _renewal_vnext/out/sf_mcp_intro.csv (opp_id18,intro_call,intro_call_date) — write a row for EVERY queried Open/PF opp (Y and N).

recert_status.object: Ticket__c (recert tickets carry RecordType.Name='Advising Fulfillment'; identified by Recert_Status__c != null)
recert_status.field: Recert_Status__c (Picklist: 'Recert Approved','Recert Failed','Sent to carrier','Advisor action needed','Customer unresponsive', ...)
recert_status.soql: SELECT Opportunity__c, Recert_Status__c, CreatedDate FROM Ticket__c WHERE Recert_Status__c != null AND Opportunity__c IN (:batch)
recert_status.derive: recert_status = Recert_Status__c of the MOST RECENT ticket by CreatedDate per opp (current status). Only opps with a recert ticket are emitted.
recert_status.out_csv: _renewal_vnext/out/sf_mcp_recert.csv (opp_id18,recert_status) — only opps that have a recert ticket.

packets_files / packet_carriers.join: ContentDocumentLink.LinkedEntityId = opp 18-char id (packets are linked to the OPPORTUNITY, confirmed; NOT the Case)
packets_files / packet_carriers.soql: SELECT LinkedEntityId, ContentDocument.Title, ContentDocument.CreatedDate FROM ContentDocumentLink WHERE ContentDocument.Title LIKE '%Renewal Packet%' AND LinkedEntityId IN (:batch)   -- ContentDocumentLink requires LinkedEntityId equals/IN; batch <=~50 ids to keep output small
packets_files / packet_carriers.derive: packets_files = raw count of matching docs per opp. packet_carriers = carrier parsed from each Title (text after the LAST date-token [regex \d{4}-?\d{1,2}-?\d{1,2}] and before 'Renewal Packet'; if no date token, the whole pre-'Renewal Packet' text), keeping the latest CreatedDate per carrier, sorted by (latest_date, carrier), joined ' \u00b7 ' as 'Carrier (YYYY-MM-DD)'. No carrier-name canonicalization (raw title text is kept, e.g. 'UnitedHealthcare CO'). Validated 80/80 files + carriers exact vs the prior dataset.
